source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), Pay Ratio
source.quote: the fiscal 2026 annual total compensation of our CEO was $29,240,930, the fiscal 2026 annual total compensation of our median associate was $30,520, and the ratio of these amounts was 958:1.

notes: Employees: approximate head count at the January 31, 2026 fiscal year end from the FY2026 10-K (about 1.6 million in the U.S. and 0.5 million internationally; in the U.S. about 92% are hourly and 68% full-time). Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total wage or staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for fiscal 2026 is used. The considered population was about 2.1 million full-time, part-time, seasonal and temporary associates at December 31, 2025, excluding about 100,000 associates in 26 countries; annualized gross earnings were used to find the median.
